shortDescription: Industrial hydraulic cylinders for lifting, pushing, pulling, positioning, load holding, and heavy maintenance.
longDescription: ToughTorq hydraulic cylinders cover general-purpose lifting, low-height applications, hollow-plunger pulling and tensioning, mechanical load holding, high-tonnage lifting, aluminum weight-sensitive applications, telescopic lifting, and stage-lift systems. Cylinder selection should be based on required capacity, stroke, collapsed height, return method, load-holding requirement, pressure, and application geometry.
features: Hollow-plunger cylinders for pulling and tensioning

models.displayName: TTRC-50 General Purpose Single Acting Hydraulic Cylinder
models.description: General Purpose Single Acting hydraulic cylinder rated at 5 ton capacity with 0.63 in stroke.

operatingRequirements.label: Hydraulic Power
operatingRequirements.value: Use with compatible 700 bar / 10,000 psi hydraulic pump, hose, couplers, and control components

compatibility: Match cylinder capacity, stroke, collapsed height, return method, load direction, and hydraulic pressure to the application.
All connected hydraulic components must have compatible pressure ratings and connection interfaces.
sourceReference: ToughTorq/Kashon Single-acting Hydraulic Cylinder table; KSRC source prefix mapped to ToughTorq TTRC naming
